corrected_conclusion: OVM does NOT provide credible unlearning protection / capture recovery in this 180-200ep small-scale online fine-tune: C-latest (0.900/0.882) is indistinguishable from naive A on robust (0.882 vs 0.880); the 200ep run (0.890/0.880) equals naive A. The earlier 'robust 0.916' was a near-untrained ep10 best_safe artifact. All trained arms sit at nominal <=0.90 / robust <=0.89, below v11 original 0.918/0.910: with guard + exploration + online data, capture does NOT recover within 200 episodes. OVM's max-anchor is insufficient in this budget; possible reasons: (1) max anchor prevents value from dropping but online 50% poor trajectories still pull the POLICY; (2) 200ep too short; (3) guard-in-loop already caps recoverable capture.
